map_sha_authority.description: A pinned/configured expected_xodr_sha256 is the authoritative provenance check. When supplied, a mismatch against the staged XODR fails staging outright with 'sha256 mismatch' refusal.

synthetic_fixture_opt_out.description: When NO tile manifests are present in the input (synthetic test fixtures), strict per-tile provenance is NOT enforced. The XODR check itself must pass, but tiles without manifests are allowed. This is a documented backward-compatibility contract.

strict_provenance_trigger.description: Strict per-tile provenance enforcement activates ONLY when at least one input tile carries a manifest sidecar (.tile_fbx.json with source_provenance.map_of_record_sha256). In strict mode: missing manifest = FAIL, manifest SHA mismatch = FAIL, mixed generations = FAIL.

package_validation_provenance.description: validate_staged_package enforces tile provenance when any staged tile has a manifest (has_any_tile_manifest). It also verifies per-tile content hashes against the sidecar manifest (tiles_fbx_sha256) to detect post-staging FBX substitution.

descriptor_provenance_binding.description: package.json carries xodr_sha256; the sidecar manifest (<PackageName>.large_map_package.json) carries canonical_source.xodr_sha256, xodr.sha256, and tiles_provenance. All must agree.
